slides.title: FLA Case Study FTT#344 ● ● ●
slides.body:
FLA
Step 4 - CAN signals analysis
● Issue Visualization through signals
● Vehicle boundary conditions
● Possible root cause to address 2nd level
P2_RPM*
Engine_Speed*
TCapActual_C2 =62 Nm
P2_Torque_Achieved = 24.625 Nm
* intermediate gear ratio: 2,5 from P2 to SubTransmission2
P2_Torque_Command = 24.75 Nm
Engine Stall
Immediate Stop of HCP
Command to Open Contactor
Issue visualization and boundary
conditions confirm that DTCs in TCM
and transmission lamp are
consequence of an opening contactor
after a crank of the vehicle.
“Why did the system opened the
contactor?”
● The contactor opening was
commanded by HCP after an
engine stall during the crank
(the ICE was not able to reach
the combustion and the engine
speed came back to zero)
“In which condition the engine
declared stall ?”
● The enginedidn’t start during an
EM Low Power Start, despite 24
Nm of torque applied by P2 with
clutch2 closed at 62 Nm

slides.title: ● ● FLA Case Study FTT#344
slides.body:
Step 5 - FLA:
The transmission lamp is due to the DTC P0A3C set by TCM after an opening contactors due to a
Failed Engine Start with EM Low Power Start
The issue needs to be analyze by 2nd level:
● ECM for failed engine start with 24.75 Nm
of torque applied by P2, more than 60 Nm
at flywheel not enough to spin up the
engine until the combustion
● HCP to confirm correct command to P2
during EM Low Power Start and reaction
to engine stall
FLA

slides.title: ● ● - - - - Case Study FTT#344 FLA
slides.body:
Step 6 - FTT MHEV update - Program Validation Manager Task
● 02/09: IFLD shared
● 03/04: Issue related to a low EM torque delivered for ICE start in warm condition (over 50°C coolant
temperature). Issue will be fixed on TCM with an higher saturation offset which will be set as a
minimum saturation during EM start and with higher torque delivered on 200 and 400 engine rpm.
Possible introduction on a dedicated PCR6B4 (plan under definition)
Note from chain mail and meeting after FTT#344 opening:
- HCP confirmed correct reaction to engine stall -> immediate stop and opening contactor -> P0A3C dtc and
TransmissionLamp
- HCP confirmed torque command to P2 -> it’s calculated from the TCapActual_C2 (torque of closing Clutch2 signal of
TCM)
- ECM confirm that torque was not enough to spin up more the engine and start the combustion (60 Nm at flywheel)
- Improvement: TCM SW calibration change: higher torque applied by TCM on Clutch2 during EM Start to avoid engine
stall (P2 torque will be calculated in HCP from signal TCapActual_C2).
FLA
